description: The file defines the 'PimPluginConfiguration' class which implements 'PluginConfigurationInterface' and is responsible for setting up dependency injection bindings for employee-related services during plugin initialization.

classes.name: PimPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring plugin dependencies related to the PIM module, specifically registering EmployeeService and EmployeeSalaryService into the service container during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dependency injection by registering EmployeeService and EmployeeSalaryService into the container using provided request context.
